name: selection_and_view
steps_note: get_selection/get_concert_pitch/get_chord_symbol_spelling return a bare/no-ok value, so they only assert the tool is callable (no expect_result).

steps.prompt: Get the current selection. Call get_selection.
Get the current view settings. Call get_view_settings.
Show invisible elements. Call set_view_settings with showInvisible true.
Is concert pitch on? Call get_concert_pitch.
What is the chord symbol spelling setting? Call get_chord_symbol_spelling.
